'''J'virgo N'yen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living on [[Makeb]] until [[3638 BBY]], when she was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
J'virgo N'yen appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Makeb. She is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
